reason: ProposedEvent::ZoneChange, PendingBatchZoneMoveRequest, PendingChangeZoneIteration and WaitingFor::EffectZoneChoice carry library_shuffle (TerminalShuffle) so a merged permanent's components share the terminal shuffle's transient library position across replacement pauses and resolution-time zone choices. Older full-game and P2P peers silently drop the optional field and resume with per-component zone-default delivery, producing extra shuffle events and trigger opportunities; refuse that silent capability loss.
